claims.quote: The supply of volunteers is always expected to fully equal the demand
claims.description: A national administration balances labor supply across trades by monitoring volunteer rates.

claims.quote: This is done by making the hours of labor in different trades to differ according to their arduousness.
claims.description: Working hours are set shorter in harder trades to equalize attractiveness.

claims.quote: It is the grade to which all new recruits belong for the first three years of their service.
claims.description: Everyone serves three years as a common laborer in a national industrial army before choosing a trade.

claims.quote: Health and safety are conditions common to all industries.
claims.description: Unsafe and unhygienic working conditions are abolished across all industries.

claims.quote: Our schools are national institutions, and to have passed their tests is a proof of special abilities not to be questioned.
claims.description: Professional training is provided by free national schools open to all.

claims.quote: But as soon as the nation became the sole producer of all sorts of commodities, there was no need of exchanges between individuals that they might get what they required.
claims.description: The nation becomes the sole producer of all goods, eliminating private trade.

claims.quote: There is neither selling nor buying nowadays; the distribution of goods is effected in another way.
claims.description: Buying and selling are abolished; goods are distributed directly.

claims.quote: As to the bankers, having no money we have no use for those gentry.

A credit corresponding to his share of the annual product of the nation is given to every citizen on the public books at the beginning of each year, and a credit card issued him with which he procures at the public storehouses, found in every community, whatever he desires whenever he desires it.
claims.description: Every citizen receives an equal annual credit and a credit card to draw goods from public storehouses.

claims.quote: our credit would not be transferable, being strictly personal
claims.description: Credit cannot be transferred between citizens, so no private economic exchange exists.

claims.quote: for the nation guarantees the nurture, education, and comfortable maintenance of every citizen from the cradle to the grave.
claims.description: The state guarantees support, education and maintenance for every citizen from birth to death.

claims.quote: so we leave the question whether a man shall be a brain or hand worker entirely to him to settle.
claims.description: Individuals freely choose between manual and professional occupations after common service.

claims.quote: which was fastened with a slightness indicating that burglary was not among the perils of the modern Boston
claims.description: Burglary disappears as a threat in the new society.

claims.quote: The nation is rich, and does not wish the people to deprive themselves of any good thing.
claims.description: Saving is discouraged because the nation is wealthy and guarantees everyone's needs.

claims.quote: my waking to find myself in the year 2000
claims.description: A man sleeps for a century and wakes in the year 2000.
